headline: AI pause could pull the rug out
detail: AI has been the primary driver for your tech/chip heavy portfolio. Warnings from Wall Street about a potential industry pause directly threaten the valuation of your core holdings.
rec: Consider trimming highly concentrated or leveraged AI-dependent positions like SOXL or SPAL, or at least reviewing their stops.

headline: OpenAI boss wants AI industry to slow down
detail: This reinforces the warning about AI, coming directly from a key industry leader. A deliberate slowdown could impact growth expectations for AI-related tech and chip companies.
rec: Given the double warning on AI, re-evaluate your exposure to highly leveraged tech/chip ETFs like SOXL and SPAL.

headline: 10-year Treasury yield closes in on 5%
detail: Rising Treasury yields make future earnings less valuable, typically hurting growth stocks, especially tech and chips. A 10-year yield near 5% is a significant headwind for your concentrated portfolio.
rec: No specific trade, but this reinforces caution on tech/chip names due to broader market headwinds.

headline: Fed rate hikes won't bring down gas prices
detail: This indicates continued pressure for Fed rate hikes. Higher rates are generally negative for growth stocks and increase the cost of margin, amplifying drawdowns on your portfolio.
rec: No specific trade, but reinforces the need for caution due to rising interest rates impacting margin costs and tech valuations.
